privacy.title: Privacy Statement
privacy.intro: Newland IT-Solutions values your privacy. This privacy statement explains which personal data we process, why we do so and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paras: Newland IT-Solutions is the data controller for the processing of your personal data.
Newland IT-Solutions, Hessenbergweg 8, 1101 BT Amsterdam • KVK: 83541934 • VAT: NL003835137B29 • info@newlandit-solutions.com • +31 648 364 450

sections.heading: 2. What personal data do we process?
paras: Through our contact form we process the data you provide: name, email address, phone number, company name, address, your message and any attachments (PDF, Word or image, up to 5 MB).
We only collect data you voluntarily provide. We do not process special categories of personal data.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paras: We process your data solely for the following purposes:
• Responding to your enquiry — legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
• Delivering agreed services — legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
• Compliance with legal obligations — legal basis: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

sections.heading: 4. Third-party recipients
paras: We use the following processors, each covered by a data processing agreement or Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs):
• Resend Inc. (US) — sends email notifications from our contact form.
• Sanity AS (Norway/US) — CMS platform for content management, where applicable.
• Google LLC (US) — Google Maps embed on the contact page, only with your explicit consent.
We never sell your personal data or share it for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 5. Retention periods
paras: Contact data is retained for a maximum of two years after your enquiry is handled, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paras: Under the GDPR you have the following rights: access to your personal data, rectification of inaccurate data, erasure ('right to be forgotten'), restriction of processing, data portability and the right to object to processing based on legitimate interests.
You may exercise your rights by contacting us at info@newlandit-solutions.com. We will respond within 30 days.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).

sections.heading: 7. Security
paras: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against loss, unauthorised access or unlawful processing.

sections.heading: 8. Changes
paras: We reserve the right to update this privacy statement. The most current version is always available on our website.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: The Newland IT-Solutions website uses cookies and similar storage technologies. This cookie policy explains which cookies we use and how you can manage your preferences.

sections.heading: 1. What are cookies?
paras: Cookies are small text files stored by your browser on your device when you visit a website. They support the website's functionality and user experience.

sections.heading: 2. Which cookies do we use?
paras: Functional cookies: strictly necessary for the website to work. These cookies contain no personal data and are exempt from consent requirements.
Consent preference: your cookie choice is stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage, key: nwl_consent). This is not a cookie but local storage; no personal data is stored in it.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics and marketing cookies
paras: We do not place analytics or marketing cookies. We do not collect visitor statistics via third parties.

sections.heading: 4. Third parties after consent
paras: Google Maps (Google LLC, US): when you give consent via our cookie banner, a Google Maps embed is loaded on the contact page. Google may process data in accordance with their privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy).
WhatsApp: clicking a WhatsApp button takes you to the WhatsApp app or website. We do not load WhatsApp automatically; you initiate this contact yourself.

sections.heading: 5. Managing consent
paras: You can give or withdraw consent for non-functional cookies via the cookie banner at the bottom of the page. You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser's local storage.
Without consent, Google Maps is not loaded and no data is sent to Google.

sections.heading: 6. More information
paras: More information about cookies and your rights is available from the Dutch Data Protection Authority: autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl
Google's privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy
